value: Input-model sensitivity (16b): validated models band_long 45 and band_long_opt 45; models that fail validation: band 44, jointGMM 44, AB 43, mixA_lnB 43 - the invalid models under-size.
With 45 chargers and 30% more cars, about 1 driver in 158 waits more than 15 min (upper 95% bound 0.75% <= 1%).
On about 5% of weekdays at least one driver waits more than 15 min; waits concentrate on cars arriving around 14:00 (midday, while the morning cars still occupy the chargers).
The existing 52 chargers meet the rule up to about +56% more cars (+46% on Tue-Wed); 7 chargers could be released or repurposed at +30%.
